question: A car is travelling along a curved road of radius $r$. If the coefficient of friction between the tyres and the road is $\mu$, the car will skid if its speed exceeds
solution:
Friction supplies the centripetal force, up to its limit $\mu mg$:
$$\frac{mv^2}{r} \le \mu mg \;\Rightarrow\; v_{max} = \sqrt{\mu rg}$$
